peer data) simply that this host's agreement list could not be fully collected - a single snapshot

"impact": "If genuinely dead, this RID's changelog data lingers indefinitely; if not, treating it
"description": "Cross-check the RID against the current live server/topology list before
"description": "Re-run list-ruv again after a delay to rule out a slow-to-converge replica.",
"description": "Re-run ReplicationCheck and IPATopologyDomainCheck and confirm SUCCESS, plus a
clean GSSAPI bind check. This is necessary but not sufficient: true convergence requires pulling RUVs
from ALL servers, which this single-host tool cannot fully do (matching RUVCheck's own documented
limitation) - a live write-and-observe test across suppliers is the gold-standard check.",
"limitations": "A single host's RUV snapshot cannot confirm a replica is permanently gone;
cross-referencing all masters' RUVs is the only conclusive method.",
